The total includes redundant subblocks. Zero redundancy is allowed. Changes apply to the next broadcast.

Total subblocks: 1–255. Redundant subblocks: 0 to total minus one. Total minus redundant must fit the regular DATA budget. Pause timeout: 100–60000 ms. Live delay: 1000–60000 ms. Check the budget ranges.

Budgets are shared by all broadcasts. k = total minus redundant subblocks. Background and per-peer temporary limits are capped by the temporary budget. Reducing DATA slots requests migration; essential delivery continues until a replacement is ready.
